data.title: Zenit vs FC Dynamo-Makhachkala Prediction 25/10/2026 – H2H Stats, Trends, Odds & Tips - Football
data.content:
Roman Vega is suspended after picking up his fourth yellow card, but his absence isn’t a major blow-Douglas Santos has firmly secured his spot in the starting lineup. Igor Diveev remains on an individual training program, with his return to full team sessions expected next week, ruling him out of the clash against Dynamo. The outlook is brighter for Wendel: the Brazilian could make the squad, although a final decision will be taken just before kickoff. Karapukas is set to start once again in [...] ### Dynamo-Makhachkala

Dynamo face a significant blow at the back: Shumakhov remains sidelined with a long-term cruciate ligament injury. Alarcon, who suffered a head injury in September, has rejoined the squad, but his match fitness is still in doubt. Otherwise, Evseev will have to rely on the available players-squad depth has always been an issue for the Makhachkala side.

## 🟨 Yellow Card Prediction [...] Zenit are hitting their stride and should secure a win at home, but their defense has looked shaky for some time. Dynamo consistently find the net on the road, with both Glushenkov and Sobolev in excellent form. Mahachkala’s away fixtures average an impressive 4.17 goals per game-the highest mark in the league. Zenit have scored three goals in each of their last three RPL matches. Our prediction: a 3-1 scoreline. The main bet for this fixture is over 3 total goals.
